findings: The programmatically built menu bar had no Services menu, so macOS hosted Services (including translation) were unreachable. AppMenus now supplies an empty Services NSMenuItem with a submenu and assigns NSApp.servicesMenu so the system can populate it; the running candidate shows 9 items.

The Edit menu had no Spelling and Grammar submenu, so the standard native spelling routes could not be reached. AppMenus now adds Show Spelling and Grammar (AppDelegate.showSpellingAndGrammar -> NSSpellChecker.shared.spellingPanel), Check Document Now, Check Spelling While Typing, Check Grammar With Spelling and Correct Spelling Automatically.

Grammar checking was never enabled. WriterWindowController.install now sets editor.isGrammarCheckingEnabled = true; continuous spell checking was already on and automatic substitutions/completion remain off.

Undo left the document looking modified: applyObserved unconditionally called updateChangeCount(.changeDone), so undoing every edit still reported an unsaved document. It now calls .changeUndone for an .undo origin.
The status line compared the saved snapshot by revision identity, so a document whose bytes matched the file still read Unsaved after an undo/redo. It now compares exact documentID and UTF-8 bytes.

not_measured: Reduce Motion behaviour: the only remaining M14 item. The app reads NSWorkspace.shared.accessibilityDisplayShouldReduceMotion in typewriterScroll() (WriterWindowController.swift:293) and, when set, keeps the caret visible with the smallest scroll jump instead of recentring the page. The host has reduceMotion unset (off) and the setting cannot be changed from here: defaults write com.apple.universalaccess reduceMotion -bool true is refused ('Could not write domain com.apple.universalaccess') and the key is still absent afterwards. The candidate's screenshots are readable, so an owner switching Reduce Motion on in System Settings is the exact missing step before the scroll-offset difference is measurable.

blockers.detail: Only Reduce Motion is left for M14.
